cards.text: Some time later, there's a feast of the Jews, and Jesus goes up to Jerusalem. Near the Sheep Gate there's a pool called Bethesda, and on its five covered walkways lie a great number of the sick, the blind, the lame and the paralyzed. One man there has been an invalid for a long, LONG time.

cards.question: How long has this man by the pool at Bethesda been an invalid?

cards.text: Jesus sees him lying there and realizes he's spent a long time this way. So Jesus asks him a question.

cards.question: What does Jesus ask the man lying by the pool?

answers.text: Do you want to get well
Do you believe I can do this
Why are you lying out here

cards.question: You'd think the man would shout YES. Instead, he tells Jesus about a problem he has with the pool when the water is stirred. What is it?

answers.text: He has no one to help him in
The guards keep him away from it
The priests say he is unclean

cards.text: And while he's on his way, someone else goes in before him. That's circling the parking lot, spotting the open space, and watching somebody zip right into it. EVERY. TIME.

cards.question: Jesus doesn't help the man into the pool at all. What does Jesus tell him instead?

answers.text: Get up and pick up your mat and walk
Go and wash in the pool of Siloam
Go and show yourself to the priests

cards.question: After Jesus speaks, the man slowly gets better over the next few days.

cards.text: Thirty-eight years an invalid, and now he's up and WALKING. Then comes one quiet little detail: this happened on the Sabbath day.

cards.question: The Jews see the healed man and tell him it's the Sabbath, so it's unlawful for him to ___ his mat.
The healed man answers that he's only doing what the man who made him ___ told him to do.

cards.text: So the Jews ask who told him to pick it up and walk. And the healed man's got NOTHING. Not a name, not a nickname, NOTHING.

cards.question: Why doesn't the healed man know who healed him?

answers.text: Jesus had slipped away in the crowd
Jesus told him to keep it quiet
He forgot it in all the excitement

cards.text: Afterward, Jesus finds the man at the temple. And Jesus has something to say to him.

cards.question: When Jesus finds the healed man at the temple, He tells him to stop sinning, or something worse may happen to him.
After meeting Jesus at the temple, the healed man keeps Jesus's name a secret.

cards.text: Now because Jesus is doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jews begin to persecute Him. But Jesus has an answer for them.

cards.question: When the Jews persecute Jesus over the Sabbath, how does He answer them?

answers.text: My Father is working and so am I
The Sabbath was made for man
I came to fulfill the Law

cards.question: Jesus breaking the Sabbath is the only reason the Jews try even harder to kill Him.

cards.text: Not only was He breaking the Sabbath, He was even calling God His own Father, making Himself equal with God. And friend, Jesus isn't done talking.

So Jesus replies, opening with "Truly, truly, I tell you…" When Ruby, my bell-shaped cookie cutter kid, had something to say, the whole kitchen stopped to listen, and friend, THIS is a stop-and-listen moment.

cards.question: Jesus says the Son does things on His own, apart from what He sees the Father doing.

cards.text: The Father loves the Son and shows Him all He does, and He will show Him even greater works than these. GREATER? Friend, I'm on the edge of my gold base.

cards.question: Jesus says that just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, the Son also gives life to whom He wishes.
Jesus says the Father judges no one but has assigned all judgment to the Son. Why?

answers.text: So all may honor the Son like the Father
So the Father can rest from His work
So the Son can test the priests

cards.question: Jesus says whoever hears His word and believes the One who sent Him won't come under judgment. That person has crossed over from death to ___.

cards.text: Another "Truly, truly…" from Jesus: the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live. The Father has granted the Son to have life in Himself, and authority to execute judgment, because He is the Son of Man.

cards.question: Jesus says the hour is coming when only those who have done good will hear His voice and come out of their graves.
Jesus says those who have done good come out to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of judgment. Then He says His judgment is just. Why?

answers.text: He seeks the will of the One who sent Him
He has studied every word of the Law
The priests have approved His rulings

cards.text: Now Jesus says, "If I testify about Myself, My testimony is not valid."

cards.question: Jesus says there is no one else who testifies about Him.

cards.text: Then Jesus brings up John, the man sent from God to testify about the light (John 1:6-7), and He says John testified to the truth. Jesus doesn't accept human testimony, but He says these things so that they may be saved.

cards.question: What picture does Jesus use to describe John?

answers.text: A lamp that burned and gave light
A tree planted by the water
A city set on a hill

cards.question: Jesus says He has testimony more substantial than John's. What is it?

answers.text: The works the Father gave Him to do
The crowds that follow Him around
The praise of the temple priests

cards.text: And Jesus says the Father who sent Him has Himself testified about Him. But the Father's word doesn't abide in them, because they do not believe the One He sent.

Then Jesus says they pore over the Scriptures because they presume that by them they possess eternal life. Those are the very words that testify about Him, yet they refuse to come to Him to have life.
Then Jesus says He does not accept glory from men. But He knows them, and they do not have the love of God within them.

cards.question: Jesus says He came in His Father's name, and they have not received Him. Who does He say they WILL receive?

answers.text: Someone who comes in his own name
Someone who comes with signs from heaven
Someone the high priest sends to them

cards.question: Jesus asks how they can believe when they accept glory from one another and don't seek the glory that comes from the only God. Then He says He won't be the one to accuse them before the Father. Their accuser is ___, the one they've put their hope in.

cards.text: Jesus says if they had believed Moses, Israel's leader, they'd believe Him, because Moses wrote about Him. Then He ends with a question that just hangs in the air: "But since you do not believe what he wrote, how will you believe what I say?"
